extracted.intended_audience: authors invited to join the Writers Guild of America (distinguished book or narrative authors considered for screen adaptation)
extracted.subtask_description: A special, invite-only pathway for distinguished authors to activate Writers Guild of America membership based on pre-screening rather than the standard credit-based route. Activation requires confirming intent and paying a one-time initiation fee; invited authors are not required to produce screen content immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Creative excellence and originality
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a primary factor in the professional pre‑screening and selection; the invitation acknowledges exceptional storytelling talent and strong literary merit. Implied expectation: distinct, high‑quality narrative voice and original work that demonstrates artistic merit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adaptability to film, TV or multimedia formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Adaptability to film, TV or multimedia formats
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluators consider an author's work for how readily it could be adapted into screen or digital media. The page emphasizes support and visibility for book‑to‑film or series adaptation and assistance for authors venturing into new media formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication history or professional writing credentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Publication history or professional writing credentials
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An author's prior publications or recognized professional credentials are used in the vetting process, indicating a record of professional practice or measurable success in writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Market and adaptation potential
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection weighs the commercial prospects and practical potential of a work to be adapted—i.e., its appeal to producers/audiences and likelihood of successful adaptation to screen or multimedia.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation-only pathway (non‑credit route)
rubrics_metrics.description: This is a special, invitation-only pathway — different from the typical credit-based screenwriting entry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invited authors have already been vetted; the pathway bypasses the standard credit‑based eligibility checks. The page explicitly contrasts this route with the standard membership route and clarifies it is rare and selective.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-time initiation fee as activation requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Once invited, authors can activate membership simply by confirming their intent and paying a one-time initiation fee.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The initiation fee is the only remaining requirement upon acceptance; no further credits or eligibility checks are required. This is presented as a simplified onboarding procedure for pre‑screened invitees.

rubrics_metrics.name: No obligation to produce screen content immediately
rubrics_metrics.description: Am I obligated to write a screenplay? No.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Membership offers adaptation support but does not require immediate production of screen content; authors retain choice over whether to pursue screenwriting.

rubrics_metrics.name: WGA contractual protections for qualifying adaptations
rubrics_metrics.description: Will WGA protect my book if adapted? Yes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Once a project qualifies under WGA coverage, members benefit from contract protections, negotiation power, guild oversight, and legal support for adaptation or screenwriting projects.
